title: Other Discoveries, 1938-40: Bethlehem
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: St. Joseph's Street, Bethlehem; placed by name.
notes: Shaft-entered chamber tomb with sunk central pit and arcosolia benches; 24 lamps, glass, beads, bronze bracelet and crosslet. (The hoard of 207 coins in the next entry is from el-Bureij, Gaza Sub-District, outside the region.)

features.subtype: chamber tomb cut in soft limestone, vertical slab-covered shaft, sunk central pit, benches under arcosolia
features.quote: A tomb chamber of the 4th—sth centuries a.p. was found
